text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The Ministry of Interior issued a new identification card for the first time in 21 years.
-Iranian Ambassador to Lebanon Ali Zadeh denies reports saying his country had sent weapons to Hizbollah (Party of God).
-The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign reserves rose by $29.41 million in the first half of March.
-The weekly treasury bill issue of March 13 raised 324.1 billion Lebanese pounds. The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against mautrity of 110.1 pounds.
-A Lebanese man convicted of killing two citizens was executed by hanging. This was the 8th execution in Lebanon since 1994.
-Acting Finance Minister Siniora said the government will impose new taxes to cover the new pay scale for state employee which is estimated at 600 billion Lebanese pounds a year.
-Italian Prime Minister arrives in Beirut today on one-day official visit.
